instructions: Press the configured hotkey in-game to execute.

#SingleInstance Force

; ==============================================================================
; Destiny 2 - Multi-Class Universal Skate Suite by Awoke
; Press Home for Menu | F5: Warlock Solar | F6: Warlock Prism | F7: Hunter | F8: Titan
; ==============================================================================

IniFile := A_ScriptDir . "\settings.ini"

CleanKeyVal(str) {
    str := Trim(str)
    if (str = "" || str = "None" || str = "Escape" || str = "Esc" || str = "Delete" || str = "Del" || str = "Backspace" || str = "BS" || str = "[ Press Key... ]")
        return "None"
    return str
}

; --- 1. Load Active Class State ---
IniRead, CurrentClass, %IniFile%, State, CurrentClass, Warlock Solar
CurrentClass := Trim(CurrentClass)

; --- 2. Load Universal & Dedicated Triggers (Sanitized) ---
IniRead, Key_UniLedge,    %IniFile%, Triggers, Key_UniLedge,    Shift+E
IniRead, Key_UniGround,   %IniFile%, Triggers, Key_UniGround,   Ctrl+E
IniRead, Key_WarlockPrism,%IniFile%, Triggers, Key_WarlockPrism, None
IniRead, Key_WarlockLedge,%IniFile%, Triggers, Key_WarlockLedge, None
IniRead, Key_WarlockGround,%IniFile%,Triggers, Key_WarlockGround,None
IniRead, Key_HunterLedge, %IniFile%, Triggers, Key_HunterLedge,  None
IniRead, Key_HunterGround,%IniFile%, Triggers, Key_HunterGround, None

Key_UniLedge     := CleanKeyVal(Key_UniLedge)
Key_UniGround    := CleanKeyVal(Key_UniGround)

Key_WarlockLedge := CleanKeyVal(Key_WarlockLedge)

; ==============================================================================
; HOTKEY BINDING & PARSER
; ==============================================================================
ParseAhkHotkey(str) {
    str := CleanKeyVal(str)
    if (str = "None" || str = "")
        return ""
    str := RegExReplace(str, "i)\bM3\b", "MButton")
    str := RegExReplace(str, "i)\bM4\b", "XButton1")
    str := RegExReplace(str, "i)\bM5\b", "XButton2")
    
    mod := ""
    while RegExMatch(str, "i)^(Ctrl\+|Shift\+|Alt\+)") {
        if RegExMatch(str, "i)^Ctrl\+") {
            mod .= "^"
            str := SubStr(str, 6)
        } else if RegExMatch(str, "i)^Shift\+") {
            mod .= "+"
            str := SubStr(str, 7)
        } else if RegExMatch(str, "i)^Alt\+") {
            mod .= "!"
            str := SubStr(str, 5)
        }
    }
    return "*" . mod . str
}

ApplyHotkeys:
    Hotkey, IfWinActive, ahk_exe destiny2.exe

    ; Unbind previous
    if (OldUniLedge) {
        Hotkey, %OldUniLedge%, ExecUniversalLedge, Off, UseErrorLevel
        OldUniLedge := ""
    }
    if (OldUniGround) {
        Hotkey, %OldUniGround%, ExecUniversalGround, Off, UseErrorLevel
        OldUniGround := ""
    }
    if (OldWP) {
        Hotkey, %OldWP%, ExecWarlockPrism, Off, UseErrorLevel
        OldWP := ""
    }
    if (OldWL) {
        Hotkey, %OldWL%, ExecWarlockLedge, Off, UseErrorLevel
        OldWL := ""
    }
    if (OldWG) {
        Hotkey, %OldWG%, ExecWarlockGround, Off, UseErrorLevel
        OldWG := ""
    }
    if (OldHL) {
        Hotkey, %OldHL%, ExecHunterLedge, Off, UseErrorLevel
        OldHL := ""
    }
    if (OldHG) {
        Hotkey, %OldHG%, ExecHunterGround, Off, UseErrorLevel
        OldHG := ""
    }

    ; Parse and bind new hotkeys
    ActiveUniLedge  := ParseAhkHotkey(Key_UniLedge)
    ActiveUniGround := ParseAhkHotkey(Key_UniGround)
    ActiveWP        := ParseAhkHotkey(Key_WarlockPrism)
    ActiveWL        := ParseAhkHotkey(Key_WarlockLedge)
    ActiveWG        := ParseAhkHotkey(Key_WarlockGround)
    ActiveHL        := ParseAhkHotkey(Key_HunterLedge)
    ActiveHG        := ParseAhkHotkey(Key_HunterGround)

    if (ActiveUniLedge != "") {
        Hotkey, %ActiveUniLedge%, ExecUniversalLedge, On, UseErrorLevel
        OldUniLedge := ActiveUniLedge
    }
    if (ActiveUniGround != "") {
        Hotkey, %ActiveUniGround%, ExecUniversalGround, On, UseErrorLevel
        OldUniGround := ActiveUniGround
    }
    if (ActiveWP != "") {
        Hotkey, %ActiveWP%, ExecWarlockPrism, On, UseErrorLevel
        OldWP := ActiveWP
    }
    if (ActiveWL != "") {
        Hotkey, %ActiveWL%, ExecWarlockLedge, On, UseErrorLevel
        OldWL := ActiveWL
    }
    if (ActiveWG != "") {
        Hotkey, %ActiveWG%, ExecWarlockGround, On, UseErrorLevel
        OldWG := ActiveWG
    }
    if (ActiveHL != "") {
        Hotkey, %ActiveHL%, ExecHunterLedge, On, UseErrorLevel
        OldHL := ActiveHL
    }
    if (ActiveHG != "") {
        Hotkey, %ActiveHG%, ExecHunterGround, On, UseErrorLevel
        OldHG := ActiveHG
    }
return

; ==============================================================================
; UNIVERSAL SMART ROUTERS (ROBUST SUBCLASS DETECTION)
; ==============================================================================
ExecUniversalLedge:
    c := Trim(CurrentClass)
    if InStr(c, "Hunter")
        gosub, ExecHunterLedge
    else if InStr(c, "Prism")
        gosub, ExecWarlockPrism
    else
        gosub, ExecWarlockLedge
return

ExecUniversalGround:
    c := Trim(CurrentClass)
    if InStr(c, "Hunter")
        gosub, ExecHunterGround
    else if InStr(c, "Prism")
        gosub, ExecWarlockPrism
    else
        gosub, ExecWarlockGround
return

; ==============================================================================
; CLICK-TO-PRESS CAPTURE ENGINE
; ==============================================================================
OnKeyBoxClick:
    CtrlName := A_GuiControl
    GlobalActiveControl := CtrlName
    GlobalCapturedKey := ""
    
    GuiControl,, %CtrlName%, [ Press Key... ]
    
    fnMouse := Func("OnMouseCaptured")
    Hotkey, IfWinActive, Destiny 2 Multi-Class Skate Suite - Control Panel
    Hotkey, *MButton, %fnMouse%, On
    Hotkey, *XButton1, %fnMouse%, On
    Hotkey, *XButton2, %fnMouse%, On
    Hotkey, *RButton, %fnMouse%, On
    Hotkey, *WheelUp, %fnMouse%, On
    Hotkey, *WheelDown, %fnMouse%, On
    
    ih := InputHook("V L1 T6", "{LControl}{RControl}{LAlt}{RAlt}{LShift}{RShift}{LWin}{RWin}{AppsKey}{F1}{F2}{F3}{F4}{F5}{F6}{F7}{F8}{F9}{F10}{F11}{F12}{Left}{Right}{Up}{Down}{Home}{End}{PgUp}{PgDn}{Delete}{Insert}{Backspace}{CapsLock}{NumLock}{PrintScreen}{Pause}{Tab}{Enter}{Space}{Escape}")
    
    Loop {
        ih.Start()
        ih.Wait()
        
        if (GlobalCapturedKey != "") {
            GuiControl,, %CtrlName%, %GlobalCapturedKey%
            break
        }
        
        endK := ih.EndKey
        if (endK = "Escape" || endK = "Esc" || endK = "Delete" || endK = "Del" || endK = "Backspace" || endK = "BS") {
            GuiControl,, %CtrlName%, None
            break
        }
        
        k := (endK != "") ? endK : ih.Input
        if (k = "")
            continue
            
        isMod := RegExMatch(k, "i)^(LControl|RControl|LAlt|RAlt|LShift|RShift|LWin|RWin|Control|Alt|Shift)$")
        if (isMod) {
            Sleep, 180
            if (!GetKeyState("Ctrl", "P") && !GetKeyState("Shift", "P") && !GetKeyState("Alt", "P")) {
                cleanMod := RegExReplace(k, "^[LR]", "")
                GuiControl,, %CtrlName%, %cleanMod%
                break
            }
            continue
        }
        
        mods := ""
        if GetKeyState("Ctrl", "P")
            mods .= "Ctrl+"
        if GetKeyState("Shift", "P")
            mods .= "Shift+"
        if GetKeyState("Alt", "P")
            mods .= "Alt+"
            
        if (StrLen(k) = 1)
            k := Format("{:U}", k)
        else
            k := RegExReplace(k, "^[LR]", "")
            
        GuiControl,, %CtrlName%, % mods . k
        break
    }
    
    Hotkey, *MButton, Off
    Hotkey, *XButton1, Off
    Hotkey, *XButton2, Off
    Hotkey, *RButton, Off
    Hotkey, *WheelUp, Off
    Hotkey, *WheelDown, Off
    Hotkey, IfWinActive
    
    GuiControl, Focus, DummyHiddenBtn
return

OnMouseCaptured() {
    global GlobalCapturedKey
    btn := SubStr(A_ThisHotkey, 2)
    mods := ""
    if GetKeyState("Ctrl", "P")
        mods .= "Ctrl+"
    if GetKeyState("Shift", "P")
        mods .= "Shift+"
    if GetKeyState("Alt", "P")
        mods .= "Alt+"
        
    GlobalCapturedKey := mods . btn
}

; ==============================================================================
; MACRO EXECUTION ROUTINES
; ==============================================================================
SendKey(k, state := "") {
    if (k = "" || k = "None")
        return
    k := RegExReplace(k, "i)\bM3\b", "MButton")
    k := RegExReplace(k, "i)\bM4\b", "XButton1")
    k := RegExReplace(k, "i)\bM5\b", "XButton2")
    
    if InStr(k, "Shift+") {
        subKey := SubStr(k, 7)
        SendInput, {Shift down}{%subKey% %state%}{Shift up}
    } else if InStr(k, "Ctrl+") {
        subKey := SubStr(k, 6)
        SendInput, {Ctrl down}{%subKey% %state%}{Ctrl up}
    } else if InStr(k, "Alt+") {
        subKey := SubStr(k, 5)
        SendInput, {Alt down}{%subKey% %state%}{Alt up}
    } else {
        if (state != "")
            SendInput, {%k% %state%}
        else
            SendInput, {%k%}
    }
}

; --- 1. Warlock Ledge Skate (Dedicated Warlock Carry Timing) ---
ExecWarlockLedge:
    SendKey(HeavySwing, "down")
    Sleep, %WarlockHeavyHold%
    SendKey(HeavySwing, "up")
    Send {Space}
    Sleep, 15
    SendKey(Super)
return

; --- 2. Warlock Skate, Flat Ground (Solar Wellskate) ---
ExecWarlockGround:
    Send {Space}
    Sleep, 40
    SendKey(LightSwing)
    Sleep, 40
    Send {Space}
    SendKey(Super)
    Sleep, 100
    SendKey(Sprint, "down")
    Sleep, 100
    SendKey(Sprint, "up")
return

; --- 3. Warlock Prismatic Flat Ground Skate (Jump after Rift Cancel) ---
ExecWarlockPrism:
    ; 1. Swap to Sword (Eager Edge proc)
    if (SwapDelay > 0 && PowerWeapon != "" && PowerWeapon != "None") {
        SendKey(PowerWeapon)
        Sleep, %SwapDelay%
    }
    
    ; 2. Heavy Attack
    SendKey(HeavySwing)
    Sleep, 20
    
    ; 3. Rift (Stores momentum)
    SendKey(ClassAbility)
    Sleep, 15
    
    ; 4. Super (Cancels Rift animation)
    SendKey(Super)
    Sleep, 15
    
    ; 5. Jump (Immediate launch right as Rift is canceled)
    Send {Space}
return

; --- 4. Hunter Ledge Skate (Independent 20ms Hold) ---
ExecHunterLedge:
    SendKey(HeavySwing, "down")
    Sleep, %HunterHeavyHold%
    SendKey(HeavySwing, "up")
    Send {Space}
    Sleep, 15
    SendKey(AirMove)
    Sleep, 100
    SendKey(Sprint, "down")
    Sleep, 100
    SendKey(Sprint, "up")
return

; --- 5. Hunter Skate, Flat Ground ---
ExecHunterGround:
    SendKey(BlockKey, "down")
    Sleep, 20
    SendKey(BlockKey, "up")
    Send {Space}
    Sleep, 45
    SendKey(LightSwing)
    Sleep, 30
    Send {Space}
    SendKey(AirMove)
    Sleep, 100
    SendKey(Sprint, "down")
    Sleep, 100
    SendKey(Sprint, "up")
return
